description: A bright, Scandinavian-minimalist foyer and staircase with a warm organic aesthetic. An open-tread staircase curves upward along the right side — the treads are solid light oak or blonde ash planks with no risers, mounted against a smooth curved plaster wall in warm taupe. The stair structure transitions to a round sculptural post at the base. At the upper landing, a framed artwork in abstract warm earth tones leans or hangs against the wall. On the left side of the foyer, a large potted olive tree in a round woven basket planter sits on a natural fiber jute rug, its silver-grey branches arching gracefully. The left wall is smooth plaster in the same warm taupe. A tall full-length window at the far right floods the entry with cool natural sidelight. Multiple elongated frosted alabaster or opal glass bottle-forms hang on thin brass cords at staggered heights in a grouped spiral cascade beside the staircase — each glowing softly with warm internal illumination. Camera at standing eye-level, wide establishing composition showing both the stair and the foyer floor together, normal to wide lens, level pitch, full room view. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
